description: Still water (0.10 m) in a closed tank 0.6 x 0.6 m (dx 10 mm) with a solid block through the free surface (S 10, x 0.20-0.45 m, top at z = 0.15625 m, 5/8 of a cell), the solid as a wall of the pressure projection (D 1 2), N 40 5 with N 59 2: the faces of the cells at the top of the block 37.5 % open, the edges of the block closed. The water stays at rest (1.2e-5 m/s, the volume to 1e-7; direct forcing 4e-3 m/s and 4e-3 of the volume).
